title: Jerome Ford Listed as Questionable for Week 13
description: Cleveland Browns running back Jerome Ford (hamstring) is listed as questionable ahead of the Week 13 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers. Ford has been limited in practice this week due to a lingering hamstring issue. The limited snaps will slap Ford with a questionable tag ahead of this contest. His absence isn't going to mean much for this Browns offense considering Ford's lack of involvement lately. Dylan Sampson could see an expanded role if Ford is unable to play. Regardless, Quinshon Judkins figures to see the majority of the snaps in the backfield.
